name: 音声案内の設定パネル
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Japanese Lighthouse catalog design candidate LH07-0009 音声案内の設定パネル.
Reference hierarchy: ORIGINAL source image(s) control icon glyph geometry, proportions, optical/stroke weight, alignment, spacing and fine control anatomy. Our saved FigCraft mock is secondary for Japanese content and overall layout; do not copy its rough substitute icons or omissions. Official Lighthouse white/forest-green/slate design and locked Japanese typography remain binding.
Input images: Image 1: original-source-reference. Image 2: secondary-component-preview. Image 3: approved-style-reference. The final approved bus style image controls only surface/gradient craft, never content or unrelated icons.
Render ONE audio guidance settings panel from original crop18,140,354,280 normalized, preserving only this crop's controls. Exact Japanese text and hierarchy: title 音声と読み上げ (Meiryo Bold20/28), label 音声案内 (Regular14/24), a TWO-segment control 消音 / 音声あり (Regular12/16), then label 消音中も通知音を鳴らす with neutral OFF switch at right (thumb LEFT), then label 案内の音量, and a THREE-segment control 小さめ / 標準 / 大きめ. Selected state is RIGHT 音声あり in first control and MIDDLE 標準 in second; show selected segments with forest-green brand gradient/white text. Unselected segments white/neutral border and slate text. All non-title text REGULAR400; tracking0. Original source controls segment equal-width geometry, inset selection corners, horizontal alignment and switch anatomy. Mock secondary for exact Japanese words; correct oversized gaps if needed while retaining compact354px logical width. Use pure-white canvas, quiet grouping without an extra enclosing card; rounded segment containers with fine neutral border, soft selected action shadow and no broad mint fill. Do not add icons, Bluetooth rows, music settings, header/back arrow or any other source content outside selected crop. Uniform enlargement for readable near-square image around1400x1200, restrained margins.
Official constraints: pure #FFFFFF outer canvas; white rounded cards, fine neutral outlines and soft downward shadows. Primary actions use smooth #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E gradient with legible white glyphs/labels and restrained edge light. Ordinary supporting icons #526173 unless a specifically justified group/state overrides. No broad mint, decorative multicolored icons, excessive gloss or invented data/features. Preserve exact Japanese text and existing Meiryo typography, weights, line heights and wrapping. Orthographic clean UI render, no phone/environment, no watermark.
Accent decision: Adapt selected segments only to consistent forest-green gradient/white labels. Unselected alternatives become neutral/slate on white to avoid excess green; OFF remains neutral.
reviewNotes: 正しい原版71d2216e、対象crop、保存mock、native文字設定を目視/読取。選択済みUnmute/Normalのみ森緑gradientへ適応、非選択はneutral/slate。生成後に9日本語文字列、右側音声あり/中央標準の選択、alerts左thumb OFF、segment構造、白背景を確認。追加Bluetooth行やglyphなし。font同一性・操作/native/所有者承認未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
